title: MMP cmb-fetch-result frame (§7, §15.8, §18.2.1)
description: Sent sealed inside control-encrypted. Carries no record: each returned record travels before it as its own cmb-encrypted frame.

returned.description: Keys whose records were sent, each as its own cmb-encrypted frame, before this result

missing.description: Requested keys not returned: not held, or not disclosable to this requester
